name: shedflare
description: A self-hosted Cloudflare app suite for personal productivity tools.

scripts.site:deploy: vp build site && vp exec alchemy deploy site/alchemy.run.ts --stage prod --yes
scripts.site:destroy: vp exec alchemy destroy site/alchemy.run.ts --stage prod --yes
scripts.deploy:anki: vp build apps/anki && vp exec jiti packages/cli/src/index.ts deploy anki --yes
scripts.destroy:anki: vp exec alchemy destroy apps/anki/alchemy.run.ts --stage prod --yes
scripts.deploy:auth: vp exec jiti packages/cli/src/index.ts deploy auth --yes
scripts.destroy:auth: vp exec alchemy destroy apps/auth/alchemy.run.ts --stage prod --yes
scripts.deploy:homepage: vp build apps/homepage && vp exec jiti packages/cli/src/index.ts deploy homepage --yes
scripts.destroy:homepage: vp exec alchemy destroy apps/homepage/alchemy.run.ts --stage prod --yes
scripts.deploy:cf-bill: vp build apps/cf-bill && vp exec jiti packages/cli/src/index.ts deploy cf-bill --yes
scripts.destroy:cf-bill: vp exec alchemy destroy apps/cf-bill/alchemy.run.ts --stage prod --yes
scripts.deploy:chat: vp build apps/chat && vp exec jiti packages/cli/src/index.ts deploy chat --yes

scripts.deploy:discord: vp exec jiti packages/cli/src/index.ts deploy discord --yes

scripts.deploy:money: vp build apps/money && vp exec jiti packages/cli/src/index.ts deploy money --yes

scripts.deploy:routines: vp build apps/routines && vp exec jiti packages/cli/src/index.ts deploy routines --yes

scripts.deploy:s: vp build apps/s && vp exec jiti packages/cli/src/index.ts deploy s --yes

scripts.destroy: vp exec alchemy destroy alchemy.run.ts --stage prod --yes
scripts.test:auth: SHEDFLARE_LIVE_ALCHEMY_TESTS=1 vp exec vitest run apps/auth/alchemy.test.ts
scripts.test:anki: SHEDFLARE_LIVE_ALCHEMY_TESTS=1 vp exec vitest run apps/anki/alchemy.test.ts
